title: Add release team
author: torydebra
body:
* Name of the new release team: hhcm_iit <!-- all lower case with words separated by `_`. -->
* Release repositories to add:
  <!--
  Before release repositories are created, repositories and packages should be submitted to the official rosdistro repository https://github.com/ros/rosdistro for naming review.
  The ros/rosdistro source entry link must be included for each repository.
  Guidelines for package naming are describe in REP-144: https://www.ros.org/reps/rep-0144.html

  If there are any existing release repositories which should have their contents imported into the ros2-gbp organization, list and link to them here.
  Leave the checkbox _unchecked_. The ros2-gbp administrator will check the box when they have completed the repository import.
  -->
  * [nicla_vision_ros](https://github.com/ADVRHumanoids/nicla_vision_ros)
    * [ros/rosdistro source entry](LINK TO SOURCE FIELD IN ROS/ROSDISTRO)
    * [ ] There is an existing release repository which should be imported: <RELEASE REPOSITORY URL>
  * [nicla_vision_ros2](https://github.com/ADVRHumanoids/nicla_vision_ros2)
    * [ros/rosdistro source entry](LINK TO SOURCE FIELD IN ROS/ROSDISTRO)
    * [ ] There is an existing release repository which should be imported: <RELEASE REPOSITORY URL>

* Team members
  * [@torydebra](https://github.com/ADVRHumanoids/nicla_vision_ros2/blob/f4a5c0a6ce85d8f27a9f72e7cea7f201cdd67fb5/package.xml#L14)
  * [@damigas](https://github.com/ADVRHumanoids/nicla_vision_ros2/blob/f4a5c0a6ce85d8f27a9f72e7cea7f201cdd67fb5/package.xml#L15)

comments.author: nuclearsandwich
comments.body: @torydebra I didn't add a repository for `nicla_vision_ros` in #563 since we don't require release repositories for ROS 1 packages to be in this or any other specific organization. If you'd like to have one in this org for ease, then please open another issue and add `nicla_vision_ros` to the ROS Noetic distribution.
